pages.text: Some mod features have been removed due to balance issues, not fitting the aesthetics of the modpack or simply because the developers couldn't find a way to fit them in.

pages.title: Blaze burners
pages.text: $(thing)Blaze burners$(), despite being essential to create's progression, are impossible to obtain in TerraFirmaCraft, as there is no nether. Their main function have been replaced by $(l:where_are_blaze_burners)fireboxes$().

pages.title: Levitite
pages.text: $(thing)Levitite$() and it's family of items were removed because, even if we all love antigravity technology, it strays $(o)way too far$() into the realm of magic to fit the $(o)realistic survival and victorian industrialism$() asthetic of $(#f80051)TerraFirmaNautics$().

pages.title: Minecart contraptions
pages.text: Early during development of $(#f80051)TerraFirmaNautics$(), a community poll decided to remove $(thing)minecart contraptions$() as they are extremely overpowered. So unfortunately, you $(bold)can't$() just make a 50x50 tunnel bore and worm your way around the world with just a stack of coal.
